tagline: Leading low-cost, integrated natural gas producer positioned for energy demand growth
hero_kpi_rationale: EQT is a highly efficient integrated natural gas producer positioned to serve growing energy demand from data centers, industries, and power generation. The average realized price ($/Mcfe) reflects the company's ability to maximize the value of its reserves while reducing production costs, a key element of its sustainable free cash flow strategy.

kpis.name: Average realized price
kpis.explanation: Average realized price per unit of natural gas and liquids sales, a key metric for upstream producers reflecting pricing power and hedging effectiveness.
kpis.description: EQT's average realized price for natural gas and liquids ($/Mcfe) reflects its ability to optimize reserve value despite commodity price volatility.
kpis.signal: Measures the ability to capture market value and the effectiveness of hedging strategy.

kpis.name: Natural gas sales volume
kpis.explanation: Total volume of natural gas sold in the period, measured in millions of cubic feet (MMcf).
kpis.description: EQT's natural gas sales volume reflects the scale of its production operations and its ability to develop its reserves.
kpis.signal: Indicator of production and volume growth.

kpis.name: Total liquids sales volume
kpis.explanation: Total volume of NGLs, ethane and oil sold in the period, measured in millions of barrels equivalent (Mbbl).
kpis.description: Liquids sales volume includes natural gas liquids (NGLs), ethane and oil, diversifying EQT's revenue streams.
kpis.signal: Indicator of diversification and non-natural gas revenues.

kpis.name: Upstream adjusted operating revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues from natural gas and liquids sales adjusted for specific items, representing the core upstream business performance.
kpis.description: EQT's upstream adjusted operating revenues reflect the performance of its core natural gas and liquids production and sales activities.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of upstream segment profitability and revenue trends.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: Total net income attributable to EQT Corporation after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: EQT's net income reflects overall company profitability after deducting all operating costs, taxes and interest.
kpis.signal: Measures overall profitability and shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: Earnings per share (diluted)
kpis.explanation: Net income per diluted share, a key metric for assessing per-share value creation.
kpis.description: Diluted earnings per share reflects net income available to each outstanding common share.
kpis.signal: Indicator of per-share value creation and shareholder performance.

kpis.name: Proved reserves
kpis.explanation: Total proved reserves of natural gas, NGLs and oil measured in Tcfe (trillion cubic feet equivalent).
kpis.description: EQT's proved reserves of 28 Tcfe reflect its substantial resource base and operational sustainability.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of long-term viability and resource base.

kpis.name: Pipeline infrastructure
kpis.explanation: Total miles of pipeline infrastructure owned and operated by EQT across the Appalachian Basin.
kpis.description: EQT's 2,945 miles of pipeline infrastructure, synchronized with its development plan, are essential to its vertically integrated business model.
kpis.signal: Indicator of geographic coverage and transport capacity.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.33 last year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.39 billion last year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 19.1% last year.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $8.644 billion last year.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $2.039 billion last year.

kpis.name: Average realized price growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year increase in average realized price per Mcfe, reflecting improved commodity price environment and hedging strategy effectiveness.
kpis.description: EQT's 16.4% YoY average realized price growth reflects the improved commodity price environment, supported by growing energy demand from data centers, industry and power generation.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of growing energy demand and the company's ability to capture market value.

kpis.name: Natural gas volume growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year increase in natural gas sales volumes reflecting successful execution of combo-development strategy.
kpis.description: EQT's 7.3% natural gas volume growth demonstrates the effectiveness of its combo-development strategy and its ability to develop its substantial reserves.
kpis.signal: Indicator of EQT's ability to execute its development strategy and respond to growing demand.

risks.title: Operational risks related to upstream and downstream activities
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly enumerated with strong language (high-risk and costly activities). Covers drilling, production, transmission, storage and natural gas processing, exposed to accidents, equipment failures, leaks. May result in major human, material and environmental losses. Key risk factor for integrated producer.

risks.title: Aging infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: Implicitly mentioned with reference to systems in service for several decades in transmission and storage facilities. Increased risk of failures, high maintenance costs and operational disruptions.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and security threats
risks.score_rationale: Cited potentially with sabotage and terrorism. Growing risk in current geopolitical context affecting critical infrastructure. Potential major operational disruptions.

risks.title: Environmental regulations and permitting
risks.score_rationale: Frequently cited with permitting delays, hydraulic fracturing limitations, GHG emissions. Direct impact on ability to build and develop. Strong language on permitting delays and project blockages such as MVP.

risks.title: Climate change and extreme weather events
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned with potential physical impacts (floods, droughts). Can damage infrastructure, interrupt operations and increase costs. Rising trend in climate risk.

risks.title: Dependence on key compression/processing stations
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in integrated structure. A failure at a critical station would have material impact on production and cash flow. Strategic risk for vertically integrated model.

risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as key factor impacting revenues and profitability. MD&A notes expected volatility in 2026 due to macroeconomics, geopolitics (Venezuela, Russia, Ukraine, Middle East). Direct impact on all financial KPIs.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as risk that can delay projects (supply chain disruptions, equipment shortages, labor constraints). Moderate but significant impact on development timeline.

ai_positioning.summary: EQT, as a low-cost, integrated US natural gas producer, is strategically positioned to serve growing energy demand from data centers, a cornerstone of AI infrastructure. Its business model designed to generate sustainable free cash flow, its 28 Tcfe of proved reserves and its 2,945 miles of synchronized pipeline infrastructure make it a reliable and low-emission energy supplier for data center development and LNG exports.
evidence: Explicit positioning to serve growing demand, including power generation, industrial consumption, domestic data center development and LNG exports.
Only major large-scale integrated natural gas producer in the United States, capable of excellence during market volatility.
Combo-development strategy optimizing operational and capital gains, with environmental and social benefits.
Low-emissions profile and sustainability commitment, addressing data center environmental concerns.
Strong 2025 results: average realized price up 16.4%, natural gas volumes up 7.3%, adjusted upstream revenues up 24.5%.
